providers.assessment: API documentation proves access. Retrieved terms variants limit IP use to personal or internal business purposes; applicable regional/entity terms and commercial external display permission unverified. Do not apply Binance Vision archive licenses to this live stream.
API guidance refers to terms and permission for non-personal commercial use, including public endpoint data. Entity/jurisdiction and written market-data permission missing.
Baseline internal use; external display/redistribution requires applicable tier, add-ons or written agreement. Attribution and exchange permissions must be evidenced for the actual feed.

Retrieved standard terms restrict business use and third-party distribution, including derived works; a specific commercial agreement is needed. Confirm which Polygon/Massive entity and agreement govern the legacy endpoint.
